name: r4-q4-control-blob
description: Fix Q4 (new finding N2, measurement only): store.js parseControl passes a non-string value through (typeof value === 'string' ? JSON.parse(value) : value), so a BLOB conditional_control_json is a Buffer control with no fields, while Go parses the BLOB's text. A1 and A3 hold CAST('{"mode":"CONDITIONAL"}' AS BLOB) (A1 with a RESERVED occurrence), A2 is the TEXT control with the same occurrence, A4 an empty BLOB. Each gets a manual timed open; a clock tick follows.
